english.note: Use this for a person or thing treated as beyond criticism or placed in a position of special reverence, especially in 捧上神枱.

exampleSentences.english: They put him on a pedestal as soon as he debuted, so nobody dared criticize anything he did.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢一出道就畀人捧上神枱，做乜都冇人敢批評。
